title: CAS-SD1 Renderer / Derivative Profiles
selected_by_governance: Strict CASI successor after CASI-02 completed_verified; no roadmap interstitial override applies.
objective: Bind the owner-approved CAS-SD1 native/output profiles and semantic derivative-loss rules to deterministic appearance rendering without reopening CASI-01 semantic state or CASI-02 CAPP resolution.

include: bind cas_sd_full_body 128x160 native to 256x320 standard output
bind cas_sd_portrait 96x96 native to 192x192 standard output
bind cas_sd_token 64x64 native to 128x128 standard output
bind Retrobit detailed/normal/micro semantic re-render profiles
declare view-specific projection losses rather than semantic deletion
exclude: PAPT asset generation or production execution
freeform raster warp, subpixel placement or antialias repair
Character mechanics, biology or equipment-truth mutation

acceptance: all six locked CAS-SD1/Retrobit profiles resolve deterministic native/output metadata
smaller profiles are semantic rerenders or declared view projections, never arbitrary bitmap shrink
projection losses are explicit and do not rewrite semantic appearance state
focused Linux/Windows deterministic validation is green
active_substep: Establish causal RED tests for the six locked CAS-SD1/Retrobit profiles and their MCCS-13 projection-loss binding, then implement the minimum deterministic profile binder to GREEN.
next_action: On work/casi-03-cas-sd1-derivative-profiles, add focused failing CASI-03 tests before implementation.
